name: Perseverance: Part 1
source:
Perseverance: Part 1 is the first installment of a horror & drama story revolving around two different characters whose paths will cross in a middle of horrific events.

In Part 1 you play as Jack Cutter, a father who is struggling to keep his family together. He's a ‘go-to' guy in his hometown of Grey Ville. On the surface Grey Ville looks like a peaceful city, but research conducted in a nearby military base gives the town a mysterious aura. Residents prefer to stay away from it, however, they love to speculate on what's going on there. Things take an unexpected turn and the area is quarantined.

Meanwhile a mysterious woman is after a fugitive. Her superiors expect her to fulfill her orders as usual. But they are not telling her everything. The person she’s after is more than what she appears to be.

Soon both Jack and the mystery agent will find themselves in a middle of a crisis that will change them forever.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/854870/Perseverance_Part_1/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《坚持：第一部》是一部恐怖与剧情故事，围绕两名不同角色展开；他们的道路将在恐怖事件中交汇。

第一部中，你将扮演杰克·卡特，一名努力维系家庭的父亲。他是灰镇的“万能先生”。表面上，灰镇是一座宁静城市，但附近军事基地开展的研究给城镇蒙上一层神秘色彩。居民喜欢远离基地，却热衷猜测那里究竟发生了什么。事情突然转向意料之外，整个地区被隔离。

与此同时，一名神秘女子正在追捕一名逃犯。她的上级希望她像往常一样完成命令，但并没有告诉她全部真相。她追捕的人远比表面看起来更加复杂。

很快，杰克和神秘特工都会陷入一场永远改变他们的危机。

（来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/854870/Perseverance_Part_1/]Steam[/url]）
